name: Steamed Basmati Rice
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: If adding saffron, soak it in a tbsp or two of hot water for 10 minutes, and add the water and strands in with the lemon juice.
Rinse the rice in a sieve for 5–7 minutes under cold running water.
Add the water, rice, butter, and salt to a pot.
Mix in lemon juice and the saffron mixture if using.
Cover the pot tightly, reduce heat to minimum, and simmer for 8½ minutes.
Taste the rice to check its texture. Cook for 1–5 minutes longer depending on how underdone it is.
Fluff with a fork and serve hot with your favorite recipe.

culture.text: Basmati is a variety of long, slender-grained aromatic rice which originates from the Indian subcontinent, mainly in the regions of Haryana, Punjab, Sindh and many other states and provinces of India, Pakistan and Nepal. As of 2019, India accounted for 65% of the international trade in basmati rice, while Pakistan accounted for the remaining 35%. Many countries use domestically grown basmati rice crops; however, basmati is geographically exclusive to certain districts of India and Pakistan.
